description:
UN Comtrade trade-flow data for prospect research. The free public preview
endpoint exposes country-pair, HS-code-filtered trade volumes (CIF/FOB value,
net weight, quantity) — the data ocean-freight forwarders need to identify
which buyers in a target country imported a commodity from China last year.
Reference files publish country and HS-code maps so commands can take
ISO codes / human-readable HS codes instead of numeric Comtrade codes.

tools.name: reporters_list
tools.description: Fetch the full Comtrade reporter (country) reference file. Returns the ReportersResponse.

tools.name: trade_preview
tools.description: Fetch annual trade-flow records (no auth, ~500 records max). Required: reporterCode. Optional: partnerCode (default: 0), period, cmdCode (plus 4 more). Returns the TradeResponse.

params.name: reporterCode
params.description: Reporter (importer) country numeric code (e.g. 818 = Egypt, 156 = China, 842 = USA). Use `webprofile-pp-cli reporters` to look up codes.

params.name: partnerCode
params.description: Partner (exporter) country code (e.g. 156 = China, 0 = world). Default 0 if omitted.

params.name: period
params.description: Year (e.g. '2023') or comma-separated years ('2021,2022,2023'). Default last full year.

params.name: cmdCode
params.description: HS commodity code (2-digit chapter to 6-digit detail; e.g. '8517' for telephones, '6109' for T-shirts). Default 'TOTAL'.

params.name: flowCode
params.description: Trade flow: M=imports, X=exports, MIP=re-imports, XIP=re-exports. Default M.

params.name: motCode
params.description: Mode of transport (0=all). Defaults to all modes.

params.name: maxRecords
params.description: Max records to return (preview is capped at ~500).
